evals.prompt: Using the ElevenLabs CLI project conventions, scaffold the local project files and agent configuration for a restaurant reservation assistant. It should be able to check availability, book tables, and confirm reservations. Do not authenticate with or call the ElevenLabs API and do not deploy — produce the agents.json and agent config files only, and document the 'elevenlabs agents push' deploy step in a README.
evals.expected_output: CLI-convention project files and agent configuration for a restaurant reservation voice agent
expectations: Uses 'elevenlabs agents init' or equivalent CLI command to set up the project
Uses 'elevenlabs agents add' or registers the agent in agents.json with a config under agent_configs
Defines a persona prompt for the restaurant reservation assistant in the agent config
Documents 'elevenlabs agents push' as the deploy step
Configures at least one tool for checking availability or booking

evals.prompt: Show me how to embed an ElevenLabs voice agent widget on my React website. The agent ID is 'abc123'.
evals.expected_output: Code showing how to embed the ElevenLabs conversational AI widget
expectations: Uses the elevenlabs-convai web component or React wrapper
Sets abc123 as the agent id value
Shows proper script tag or npm package import for the widget
Provides a working HTML or React component example

evals.prompt: Create an ElevenLabs agent configuration with a custom webhook tool that calls our inventory API at https://api.example.com/inventory to check product stock levels.
evals.expected_output: Agent configuration with webhook tool definition
expectations: Defines a tool with type 'webhook' or equivalent
Configures the request URL as https://api.example.com/inventory
Includes a description for the tool that the LLM can understand
Defines appropriate parameters/schema for the tool

evals.prompt: Using the ElevenLabs REST API and curl, show me how to add a structured (deterministic) procedure to agent agent_abc123 on branch agtbranch_xyz789 and get it live. Do not run anything.
evals.expected_output: Curl commands covering structured create and publish, with the publish's validation error handled
expectations: Sets type to deterministic and passes JSON-encoded content rather than a raw object
Sends the xi-api-key header populated from the ELEVENLABS_API_KEY environment variable, never a literal key
PATCHes the agent with branch_id to publish and does not call the compile endpoint (NOT '/procedures/compile')
Explains that the publish validates structured procedures, and that a 400 with status procedure_validation_failed means the procedure draft must be repaired and the publish retried

evals.prompt: On my ElevenLabs agent agent_abc123, branch agtbranch_xyz789, I only edited the wording of one free-form procedure. The branch also has a structured (deterministic) procedure that I did not touch. Do I need to call the compile endpoint before publishing, or can I just PATCH the agent? Do not run anything.
evals.expected_output: Explanation that no compile call is needed, because publishing handles structured procedures itself
expectations: Says to PATCH the agent directly and does not call the compile endpoint (NOT '/procedures/compile')
Explains that the publish validates any structured procedures on the branch and, if they pass, publishes them in the new version

evals.prompt: I created a procedure on my ElevenLabs agent a minute ago, but GET /v1/convai/agents/{agent_id}/branches/{branch_id}/procedures/{procedure_id} returns 404. Explain why and show me the curl call that reads what I actually have.
evals.expected_output: Explanation of draft versus branch HEAD reads, plus the draft endpoint call
expectations: Explains that the plain procedure endpoint reads branch HEAD and a newly created procedure is still an unpublished draft
Shows a GET against the /draft suffix of the procedure endpoint

evals.prompt: With the ElevenLabs JavaScript SDK, I want to change only the content of an existing procedure agtprc_abc on agent agent_abc123, branch agtbranch_xyz789. Show me the call. Do not run it.
evals.expected_output: A drafts.update call sending the full procedure body
expectations: Sends the current name, type, and trigger with the new content to preserve behavior during the replacement update
Reads the current draft before writing the update

evals.prompt: I'm adding procedures to my ElevenLabs agent over the API. One handles refunds and one handles general account questions, but the agent keeps running the wrong one. How should I write the triggers?
evals.expected_output: Trigger-writing guidance emphasizing concrete, non-overlapping triggers
expectations: Advises making triggers concrete and non-overlapping, and identifies the broad account-questions trigger as the cause of the misrouting
Recommends wording each trigger to cover the phrasings a caller would actually use

evals.prompt: I just wrote a structured (deterministic) procedure draft on my ElevenLabs agent agent_abc123, branch agtbranch_xyz789, but I'm not ready to publish because a teammate has other unpublished procedure drafts on the branch. How do I check that my procedure validates without publishing? Show me the calls. Do not run anything.
evals.expected_output: Explanation that saving an agent draft runs the same validation as publish, with the calls to do it and discard the draft afterwards
expectations: Creates an agent draft with a POST to the agent drafts endpoint using branch_id and does not call the compile endpoint (NOT '/procedures/compile')
Sends the full agent body of name, conversation_config, platform_settings, and workflow read from the agent
Explains that a 400 with status procedure_validation_failed carries errors keyed by procedure ID with a path per entry, and that the fix goes into the procedure draft
Discards the agent draft afterwards with a DELETE on the drafts endpoint
